recent: EGH International 于2026年10月16日在ACE市场上市，首次公开募股（IPO）发行3.6亿股，每股RM0.16。公司2026财年第二季度（截至9月30日）净利润为417万令吉，主要受家具销售增长推动。近期，一家子公司收到103万令吉的清盘呈请，同时公司董事及主要股东在IPO后出现股权变动。
notable: 公司于2026年10月16日在ACE市场上市，IPO发行3.6亿股，每股RM0.16。
2026财年第二季度净利润为417万令吉，高于上一季度。
risks: 一家子公司收到103万令吉的清盘呈请。
公司董事及主要股东在IPO后出现股权变动，包括Dato' Lim Yuk Meng的股权稀释。
earnings: 2026财年第二季度（截至9月30日）营收为5867.1万令吉，净利润为408.2万令吉，净利率7.0%。

recent_en: EGH International listed on the ACE Market on 16 October 2026 via an IPO of 360 million shares at RM0.16 per share. The company posted a net profit of RM4.17 million for the second quarter ended 30 September 2026, driven by higher furniture sales. Recently, a subsidiary received a RM1.03 million winding-up petition, while directors and substantial shareholders saw changes in their shareholdings after the IPO.
notable_en: The company listed on the ACE Market on 16 October 2026 via an IPO of 360 million shares at RM0.16 per share.
Net profit for the second quarter of FY2026 was RM4.17 million, higher than the previous quarter.
Group Managing Director Dato' Lim Yuk Meng holds a 31% stake following the IPO.
risks_en: A subsidiary received a RM1.03 million winding-up petition.
Directors and substantial shareholders saw changes in shareholdings after the IPO, including dilution of Dato' Lim Yuk Meng's stake.
earnings_en: For the second quarter ended 30 September 2026, revenue was RM58.671 million, net profit was RM4.082 million, with a net margin of 7.0%.
